title: Makes your holiday table shine
text: Makes your holiday table shine. I purchased the Lenox "Holiday Nouveau" 70" round tablecloth to coordinate with several Lenox Holiday Nouveau serving pieces. Crafted of 58% cotton, 42% polyester and machine-washable (cold water with like colors), the ivory-on-ivory holly leaves catch the light and make the tablecloth shimmer, while the tartan ribbon is accented with holly and berries. Be sure to pick up the matching napkins for a gorgeous presentation!
